{{Recipe summary
| Category = Shrimp recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients == 
* 20 fresh uncooked large [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] 
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 3 slices (or more as needed) sandwich [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onion]], finely-chopped 
* 4 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]]
* 3 tbsp [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]

== Procedure ==
# Remove shells and tails from shrimp. Remove back veins from shrimp. Cut down back of shrimp with sharp knife. [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] shrimp into a very small dice.
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] 1 egg, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and finely-chopped green onions in a small bowl until blended.
# Add shrimp to egg mixture, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] until shrimp are completely coated.
# Remove crusts from bread. Cut each slice into quarters.
# Place one spoonful of shrimp mixture on each piece of  bread. Gently press to adhere to bread.
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] or rub small amount of egg mixture over each shrimp toast. 
# Dip moist side into the sesame seeds spread out on a plate. 
# Heat oil in [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C). 
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] 3–4 shrimp toast pieces at a time in the hot oil until golden, 1–2 minutes on each side. Drain on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|absorbent paper]].
